description: List every sale of your listings (you are the seller) with order id, listing, payment method, status, price, what you receive after fees and the payout date, plus on-hold and paid-out totals. Unpaid and cancelled orders are left out; there is no pagination. Use list_purchases for things you bought, get_order for one order and get_balance for payout status. Needs your API key.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

name: get_sales
title: My sales
